verdict.rationale: Gusto publishes a documented API: a reference site, API fundamentals covering pagination, rate limits and scopes, a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, a date-based versioning and deprecation policy, and a demo sandbox. However, its own docs state the API is restricted to App Integration and Embedded Payroll partners, so it is not openly usable by any customer or user. missing for 10: open (non-partner) API access for ordinary users, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end to end via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This site serves as both a technical reference for the endpoints available and a general overview of payroll.
The Gusto API is currently restricted to [Gusto App Integration](https://gusto.com/product/integrations) and [Embedded Payroll](https://embedded.gusto.com/) partners.
The Gusto Embedded API behavior is built on core fundamentals that apply to every endpoint.
Gusto uses date-based versioning to provide stability while continuously improving our services.
